# earthquery

earthquery turns plain English into vector search over satellite imagery embeddings.
Ask "solar farms in deserts" and get matching locations on a map, ranked by embedding similarity.

## Status: demo index (v1)

v1 searches a bundled demo index of 489 tiles (Southern Ontario grid plus 20
world-region anchors) with deterministic 64-dim concept vectors. These are NOT
real satellite measurements. The pipeline (query -> embedding -> cosine search
-> ranked tiles) is real and provider-agnostic. Production design: EmbeddingGemma 2
(Apache 2.0) for queries, AlphaEarth Satellite Embedding V1 (CC-BY 4.0, Google
Earth Engine dataset GOOGLE_SATELLITE_EMBEDDING_V1_ANNUAL) for tiles.
Never present demo results as satellite analysis.

## API (no key in v1)

- GET /api/search?q=solar+farms+in+deserts&limit=12
  Returns { query, provider, dimensions, tile_count, matched_concepts, demo, results }.
  Each result: { tile_id, bbox: [south, west, north, east], center: [lat, lng],
  score: 0-100, tags }. HTTP 400 when q is missing. Empty results array when the
  query matches no known concepts.
- GET /api/health
  Returns { status, version, provider, dimensions, tiles, coverage, demo }.
- GET /llms.txt (this file)

## Examples

curl "https://earthquery.app/api/search?q=container+ports&limit=5"
curl "https://earthquery.app/api/health"
